name: The Alliance Needs More Stranglekelp!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs More Stranglekelp!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well hello again there... What was it? Ah yes, friend! Come to see if I still need more stranglekelp have you? Well, it's your lucky day, because the answer to that very important question is a very affirmative YES! Think you could gather up twenty more?

clips.title: Progress

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh goodness that's a quite a load of stranglekelp you have there. Quick, let's get that into a box to keep it fresh. You've done me... Us, the Alliance a great favor by bringing that batch in. I'll make sure that everyone knows that it was you, the great friend, that helped to tip the scales in the Ahn'Qiraj war effort with your contribution of stranglekelp!
